decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel draws directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication knowledge, so its own R&D can keep improving it, and it remains central to binding mobile communication.
Mobile PDF signing fits the online contract signing direction and the firm's signature know-how, though as a narrow feature it may later be absorbed into a broader suite.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the backbone of the integrated offering and the clearest application of the firm's accumulated security expertise.

The QR-based hardware token still serves regulated customers and builds on the firm's hardware and authentication experience, but the shift toward app-based authentication by 2022 makes withdrawal a growing risk.
